digest.en: Anti-government protests in Moscow and St. Petersburg have spiraled out of control, drawing thousands onto the streets and prompting a heavy police response.
digest.hi: बांग्लादेश के सामने भारत ने शेख हसीना को रिहा करने के लिए दो शर्तें रखी, जिसमें सीमा सुरक्षा और जल संसाधन साझा करना शामिल है। इसी दौरान यूक्रेन को डेनमार्क ने 645 मिलियन यूरो का रक्षा पैकेज दिया, जबकि यूके ने रूसी तेल पर प्रतिबंध कड़ा।

articles.title: How anti-Government protests spiralled out of control
articles.summary: French authorities deployed thousands of arrests and police beatings to suppress anti-government protests. The heavy-handed response deepened public grievances. The unrest shows no sign of abating before next year's presidential election. The French authorities’ heavy-handed response, including thousands of arrests, police beatings and curbs on marches, has added to the volatile mix of grievances fuelling an anti-Government groundswell that shows no sign of abating before next year’s presidential election.

articles.title: Canada PM Carney touts Philippine trade deal on Asia tour
articles.summary: Canadian Prime Minister Mark Carney announced a trade deal with the Philippines during an Asia tour. The agreement will eliminate over 90 percent of tariff lines. It covers agriculture, aerospace, and artificial intelligence. Signing is expected within six months. The deal will drop over 90 per cent of tariff lines and cover areas ranging from agriculture to aerospace to artificial intelligence, and is about six months away from being signed, says Canada's prime minister.

articles.title: Ethereum’s ERC-8415 tests tokenization’s ownership gap
articles.summary: OKXICE plans to launch 24-hour trading for tokenized securities for US investors on November 23. The venture is a joint effort between OKX and Intercontinental Exchange. Most companies in the initial lineup objected to inclusion. This resistance highlights ownership gaps in tokenization. On November 23, OKXICE, a joint venture between crypto exchange OKX and New York Stock Exchange owner Intercontinental Exchange, plans to let eligible US investors trade tokenized securities around the clock.

articles.title: Former Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang misled top lawyer on affair with Alice Huang: report
articles.summary: Jensen Huang told Nvidia's top lawyer his relationship with Alice Huang was appropriate during 2025 and 2026. He made these statements after press inquiries drew executive attention to his ties with Megaspeed. The report details his repeated assurances to legal counsel regarding the nature of their interactions. During the autumn of 2025 and in October 2026, in ‌response to press queries that drew some Nvidia leaders’ attention to his relationship with Megaspeed and Alice ​Huang, Jensen Huang at both times described their interactions as appropriate.

articles.title: Amid Ongoing Battle Over Afghan Deportations, US Legislators Push Law Granting Protection
articles.summary: US legislators are pushing a new law to halt Afghan deportation flights. The plan to send 150 Afghans home sparked safety fears. Court battles have already emerged over the deportations. The proposed legislation aims to stop the flights from taking off. US plans to deport 150 Afghans back to their homeland have sparked fears for their safety and have led to court battles.

articles.title: Dollars Rain From Balcony As Kazakhstan's State Giants Rocked By Corruption Arrests
articles.summary: President Toqaev convened an urgent Security Council meeting after corruption arrests. Security services detained the heads of Samruk-Kazyna and KTZ. These entities control 40 percent of Kazakhstan's economy. Toqaev aimed to reassure foreign investors and reinforce his law and order drive. Days after security services detained the heads of Samruk-Kazyna and state railway KTZ, which control 40 percent of Kazakhstan’s economy, President Toqaev convened an urgent Security Council meeting to reinforce his “Law and Order” drive, address transport governance, and reassure foreign investors.

articles.title: Huang’s fall exposes contradictions in America’s China strategy
articles.summary: Jensen Huang resigned as Nvidia chief executive this week. His departure followed governance concerns and intelligence allegations. Washington imposed chip controls in 2022 and tightened them in 2023. Huang's fall exposed contradictions in America's China strategy. Jensen Huang’s resignation as Nvidia chief executive this week followed a convergence of corporate governance concerns, intelligence allegations and scrutiny of semiconductor exports to China.

articles.title: Fragile Gulf calm tested as threats to Hormuz shipping mount
articles.summary: The Gulf region remains tense nearly nine months after strikes on Iran. Iran has effectively closed the Strait of Hormuz to shipping. Attacks on vessels are increasing in frequency. The Security Council is meeting at Bahrain’s request to discuss the situation. Nearly nine months after Israeli and US strikes on Iran set off a regional war, the Gulf remains on a knife edge.

articles.title: Unrest fuelled by armed groups holds back response
articles.summary: Armed groups in the Democratic Republic of the Congo are obstructing Ebola response efforts. They continue attacking civilians and health workers. These disruptions hinder containment measures. UN responders reported the ongoing violence on Friday. The Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) continues to spread amid repeated and ongoing deadly attacks on civilians and frontline health workers by armed groups that are obstructing efforts to stop transmission, UN responders said on Friday.

articles.title: CENTCOM Denies Iranian Claim It Struck A US Radar In Bahrain
articles.summary: The Islamic Revolutionary Guards Corps claims it destroyed a US radar in Bahrain. This follows an overnight strike on Sirik near the Strait of Hormuz. US Central Command denied the Iranian assertion. The incident escalates regional tensions. Iran’s Islamic Revolutionary Guards Corps (IRGC) claims that it destroyed a US military early-warning radar in Bahrain in retaliation for an overnight air strike on the southern port town of Sirik, near the Strait of Hormuz.

articles.title: Did China’s ‘beauty stratagem’ find a new victim in Jensen Huang?
articles.summary: Jensen Huang resigned as Nvidia CEO following reports of an affair with Alice Huang. She is a Singapore-based executive suspected of having ties to Chinese intelligence. The incident has raised concerns about a potential honey trap targeting a major American technology leader. Extramarital activities have led to the resignation of one of America’s most influential tech bosses, Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang.

articles.title: Storm Charles causes floods and flight cancellations across southern Europe
articles.summary: Storm Charles brought heavy rain and strong winds to southern Europe. Portugal and southern Spain faced significant flooding and flight cancellations. The weather system first hit the island of Madeira before moving toward the mainland on 11 November. Heavy rain and strong winds have also caused disruption across British Columbia, Canada, over the last week Storm Charles has brought destructive weather to the Iberian peninusla this week, particularly in Portugal and the far south of Spain.

articles.title: China’s demographic challenge becoming its biotech advantage
articles.summary: The Biotechnology Innovation Organization urged Washington to adopt a national biotechnology strategy. The group warned that China is rapidly gaining ground in the sector. Biotech is now viewed as critical to economic competitiveness and national security in the U. S. Is biotechnology becoming the next space race? The Biotechnology Innovation Organization (BIO) appears to think so. This month, it urged Washington to adopt a comprehensive national biotechnology strategy, warning that China is rapidly gaining ground in an industry now viewed as critical to economic competitiveness and national security.

articles.title: Russia's Propaganda Machine Deploys Pro-War AI Songs
articles.summary: A Ukrainian nonprofit found nearly 1,000 AI-generated songs on Russian streaming platforms. The tracks support the military and the war in Ukraine. The content aims to generate patriotic sentiment among listeners. The study highlights the scale of this digital propaganda effort. Russians using streaming music sites might find a new genre turning up in their feeds: AI-generated songs in support of Russia's military and the war in Ukraine.

articles.title: Russian Diesel Tankers Turned Away From US, But Ukraine Says Moscow Is Still Finding Buyers
articles.summary: Russian diesel tankers bound for the United States changed course after failing to find American buyers. Political and legal opposition to the Trump administration's push for Russian fuel imports blocked the deals. Ukraine reports Moscow is still securing alternative buyers for the cargoes. Several Russian diesel tankers initially bound for the United States have changed course after struggling to find American buyers willing to accept the controversial cargoes, amid mounting political and legal opposition to the Trump administration's efforts to facilitate Russian fuel imports.

articles.title: Nord Stream Gas Fueled This German Power Plant, Now It's Being Dismantled And Sent To Ukraine
articles.summary: The Greifswald power plant in northeast Germany is being dismantled and shipped to Ukraine. Built at the Nord Stream pipeline landfall, the station sat idle after the gas line was sabotaged. It joins other major European energy facilities being broken up for Ukrainian use. The Greifswald industrial power plant was built at the landfall of Russia's Nord Stream pipelines in northeast Germany.

articles.title: What Happened At The Ukraine-Russia Peace Talks? Not Much.
articles.summary: White House envoys traveled to Moscow to meet Vladimir Putin following two days of peace talks in Abu Dhabi. Russian negotiators maintained hard-line demands extending beyond the Ukraine war to the post-World War II European political structure. The talks produced no immediate breakthrough. The White House envoys fly to Moscow for meetings with Putin a day after two days of peace talks in Abu Dhabi wrapped up.

articles.title: Aid is the ‘only hope’ for millions in Sudan, WFP chief warns, as funding cuts deepen hunger crisis
articles.summary: The World Food Programme chief warned that funding cuts are deepening Sudan's hunger crisis. He visited displaced families struggling to feed their children during his first field mission. Aid remains the only viable option for millions facing starvation in the conflict zone. The World Food Programme’s (WFP) new Executive Director has warned that funding cuts are worsening Sudan’s hunger crisis following his first field mission to the country, where he met families displaced by conflict and struggling to feed their children.

articles.title: New platform aims to get money moving before disaster strikes
articles.summary: UN agencies launched a joint platform at COP31 in Antalya to secure over $3 billion in risk financing. The initiative aims to protect 75 million people from climate shocks by 2030. This move seeks to move funds before disasters strike. UN agencies on Thursday launched a joint platform at COP31 in Antalya, Türkiye, that aims to secure access to more than $3 billion in risk financing to protect 75 million people and their livelihoods from climate shocks and natural hazards by 2030.

articles.title: Cities rise up the climate agenda as leaders face demands for action
articles.summary: World leaders at COP31 focused on protecting cities and vulnerable communities from climate impacts. Activists simultaneously challenged governments to implement stronger action. The human cost of rising seas and melting glaciers dominated the agenda. From flooded homes to melting Himalayan glaciers, the human cost of climate change took centre stage at COP31 on Thursday, as world leaders turned their attention to protecting cities and vulnerable communities, while activists challenged governments to do more.

articles.title: More than 1,000 killed between July and September, UN report reveals
articles.summary: A UN report states over 1,000 people were killed in Haiti between July and September. Armed gangs continue to terrorize residents in Port-au-Prince and surrounding areas. The violence persists despite ongoing international concerns. More than 1,000 people were killed in Haiti during the third quarter of this year, as armed gangs continue to terrorize the population in the capital Port-au-Prince and beyond, the UN team in the island nation, said in its latest human rights report.

articles.title: Arrests, Attacks, And A Familiar Kremlin Refrain
articles.summary: US, Ukraine, and Russia held trilateral talks in Abu Dhabi. Negotiations focused on broad security questions while deep gaps remained over Donbas territorial control. Russia continued military attacks on Ukraine and domestic crackdowns on citizens during the discussions. At the first US-Ukraine-Russia negotiations since February, talk turns to broad questions of security while wide gaps remain over core issues such as territorial control in the Donbas.

articles.title: Argentinian lawyer mocks UK’s sovereignty claim in Falklands oil case
articles.summary: Argentina's lawyer Marcelo Kohen mocked Britain's sovereignty claims in a Hamburg tribunal hearing. He argued the UK should not act as a colonial power. Kohen rejected the historic doctrine of British maritime dominance over Falklands waters. Lawyer says Britain wrong to believe in historic doctrine that crown has sovereignty over parts of oceansBritain should not be permitted to act as a 17th-century colonial power treating the waters around the Falkland Islands as a Dominium maris Britannici, Argentina has told an international tribunal. Marcelo Kohen, representing Argentina at a hearing in Hamburg, mocked Britain for apparently belie.

articles.title: Killing of journalist underscores deteriorating conditions in Ecuador
articles.summary: Ecuadorian journalist Tomás Beltrán was shot dead while parking his car in Calceta. The killing highlights deteriorating security conditions in the country. Gang warfare over drug routes has made the Pacific coastline a key flashpoint. Tomás Beltrán was shot dead amid gang warfare that has turned Latin American country into one of its most violentTomás Beltrán was manoeuvring his car into his garage on Sunday night when the Ecuadorian journalist was shot dead. Beltrán ran a Facebook page with news about Calceta, a small city in the province of Manabí, whose Pacific coastline has made it a key flashpoint in the gang warfare over d.

articles.title: From Japan to Rwanda, early warnings are saving lives – but millions remain unprotected
articles.summary: UN Secretary-General António Guterres stated that early warning systems are saving lives globally. However, millions of people still do not receive these critical alerts. He urged the international community to ensure every person on Earth is protected by the end of 2027. Early warning systems are saving lives across the globe, but for millions of people the warning never arrives, UN Secretary-General António Guterres said on Wednesday, urging the world to protect every person on Earth by the end of 2027.

articles.title: शेख हसीना को ले जाना है तो पहले माननी होंगी 2 शर्तें, बांग्लादेश के सामने भारत ने रखी मांग
articles.summary: भारत ने बांग्लादेश की पूर्व प्रधानमंत्री शेख हसीना की दिसंबर में वापसी के लिए दो शर्तें रखी हैं। इन शर्तों का उल्लेख एक रिपोर्ट में हुआ है, हालांकि भारत ने अभी तक आधिकारिक पुष्टि नहीं की है। Bangladesh Sheikh Hasina: बांग्लादेश की पूर्व प्रधानमंत्री शेख हसीना ने ऐलान किया है कि वह दिसंबर में अपने देश लौटेंगी. अब एक रिपोर्ट के मुताबिक, भारत ने उनकी वापसी के लिए दो शर्तें रखी हैं.

articles.title: वोलोदिमिर ज़ेलेन्स्की का दावा – अमेरिका ने नाटो सदस्यता के बदले यूक्रेन से डोनबास छोड़ने का दिया
articles.summary: यूक्रेनी राष्ट्रपति ज़ेलेन्स्की का दावा है कि अमेरिका ने नाटो सदस्यता के बदले यूक्रेन से डोनबास क्षेत्र छोड़ने की मांग की है। यह बयान रूस-यूक्रेन युद्ध के 56 महीने पूरे होने के बीच आया है। रूस-यूक्रेन युद्ध (Russia-Ukraine War) को 56 महीने पूरे हो चुके हैं, लेकिन इसके बावजूद युद्ध रुकने का नाम नहीं ले रहा है। रूस लगातार यूक्रेन पर हमले कर रहा है और सर्दियों के मौसम से पहले हमले बढ़ा दिए गए हैं।

articles.summary: डेनमार्क ने यूक्रेन को 645 मिलियन यूरो का नया रक्षा पैकेज देने की घोषणा की है। साथ ही ब्रिटेन ने रूस के तेल क्षेत्र पर नए प्रतिबंधों की घोषणा की है। ज़ेलेन्स्की ने इन बातों की जानकारी सोशल मीडिया पर साझा की। Denmark Defence Package: यूक्रेन के राष्ट्रपति वोलोदिमिर जेलेंस्की ने अपनी हालिया डेनमार्क और आयरलैंड यात्राओं के बाद डेनमार्क द्वारा 645 मिलियन यूरो (लगभग 4.8 अरब डेनिश क्रोनर) के नए रक्षा पैकेज और ब्रिटेन (यूके) द्वारा रूस के तेल क्षेत्र पर लगाए गए नए प्रतिबंधों की घोषणा की जानकारी दी है।

articles.summary: वियतनाम के बाक निन्ह प्रांत में सैन्य ट्रेनिंग के दौरान एक हादसे में छह सैनिकों की मौत हो गई। यह घटना राष्ट्रीय फायरिंग रेंज टीबी1 पर हुई, जहां रेजिमेंट 102 के बीएमपी-1 वाहन में समस्या आई। वियतनाम (Vietnam) के बाक निन्ह (Bắc Ninh) प्रांत के बिएन सोन (Bien Son) कम्यून में स्थित राष्ट्रीय फायरिंग रेंज टीबी1 (TB1) पर सैन्य ट्रेनिंग के दौरान एक हादसा हो गया।

articles.summary: जी. किशन रेड्डी ने तेलंगाना सरकार पर भारत समिट के लिए सरकारी धन का उपयोग करने का आरोप लगाया। उन्होंने मुख्यमंत्री से जनता को स्पष्टीकरण देने की मांग की। केंद्रीय मंत्री जी. किशन रेड्डी ने 'भारत समिट' को लेकर कांग्रेस के नेतृत्व वाली तेलंगाना सरकार पर तीखा हमला बोला है. उन्होंने सवाल उठाया है कि किस आधार पर सरकारी फंड का इस्तेमाल करके, राज्य प्रशासन के साथ मिलकर किसी राजनीतिक दल का कार्यक्रम आयोजित किया जा रहा है.

articles.summary: ट्रंप चीन दौरे पर एनवीडिया विवाद पर चुप रहेंगे। जेनसेन हुआंग ने 12 नवंबर को सीईओ पद से इस्तीफा दिया था। अमेरिका ने एलिस हुआंग के चीन संबंधों की पुष्टि नहीं की है। अमेरिकी राष्ट्रपति डोनाल्ड ट्रंप चीन के दौरे पर जाने वाले हैं. इस दौरान चीनी राष्ट्रपति शी जिनपिंग से मुलाकात करेंगे. लेकिन इस दौरान एनवीडिया विवाद को बातचीत में नहीं उठाएंगे.

articles.title: 'माइंड ऑफ इंडिया', पंडित नेहरू की जयंती पर सीजेपी ने शेयर किया वीडियो
articles.summary: कॉकरोच जनता पार्टी ने पंडित जवाहरलाल नेहरू की जयंती पर एक वीडियो शेयर किया। पार्टी ने नेहरू को 'भारत का दिमाग' और आधुनिक भारत का शिल्पकार बताया। पोस्ट में कहा गया कि नेहरू की कल्पना का निर्माण आज भी जारी है। देश के पहले प्रधानमंत्री पंडित जवाहरलाल नेहरू की जयंती पर उन्हें याद करते हुए कॉकरोच जनता पार्टी (CJP) ने उन्हें 'भारत का दिमाग' (Mind of India) बताया है.

articles.title: भारत-अमेरिका ट्रेड डील कब होगी फाइनल? एस. जयशंकर ने दिया बड़ा अपडेट
articles.summary: विदेश मंत्री एस. जयशंकर ने कहा कि भारत-अमेरिका ट्रेड डील जल्द फाइनल होगी। उन्होंने बताया कि अधिकतर मुद्दे सुलझ चुके हैं और बचे मुद्दे अमेरिका की ओर से हैं। दोनों देश संतुलित और फायदेमंद समझौते पर काम कर रहे हैं। जयशंकर ने कहा है कि भारत और अमेरिका के बीच ट्रेड डील जल्द ही पूरा होने की उम्मीद है. उन्होंने बताया कि इस समझौते से जुड़े अधिकतर मुद्दे सुलझा लिए गए हैं और अब जो कुछ मामले बचे हैं, वे भारत के बजाय अमेरिका की तरफ से ज्यादा हैं.
